===Pokémon Adventures===
Professor Turo first appeared In ''[[PASV02|Discover! The Quaking Earth Titan!!]]'', where {{Violet}} told {{adv|Arven}} how he met {{ga|Miraidon}} and Professor Turo contacted him, explaining that Miraidon was in a weakened state and that it could regain its full capacity by eating [[Herba Mystica]]. He also revealed that his son Arven was also after the Herba Mystica and that if Violet wished, they could cooperate with each other to find them.

After Miraidon ate a [[Sweet Herba Mystica]] [[sandwich]] in ''[[PASV08|Acquisition! New Ability: Dash!!]]'', Turo called Violet again through [[Old Roto]] to tell him that Miraidon had regained part of its original strength. After Miraidon ate a [[Bitter Herba Mystica]] sandwich in ''[[PASV11|Decisive! The Battle in the Sky!!]]'', Turo called Violet once more to tell him that Miraidon regained more of its strength and now could move across water.
